probes.question: Where does a credit score come from?
True or false: most credit scores range from 300 to 850.

body.question: How many credit scores does one person have?
options: Several, depending on model, data and day
body.reveal: Several. A credit score is a prediction of your credit behavior, calculated from the information in your credit reports with a scoring model. Each score depends on the model, the source of the data and even the day it was calculated. Most credit scores range from 300 to 850.
